name: drw: kernel and a block with a hole
drw: a drawing of it
drw: smart dimension picks the left edge of the top view (vertical 50)
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; await m.run('drwSmartDim'); const b = window.__viewBox('top'); window.__pt = window.__sheetToClient(b.x + 0.2, b.y + b.h * 0.3); return m.state.editing?.mode; })()

name: drw: the dimension is on the sheet
eval: (() => { const d = window.__mymechanics.active(); const a = d.annotations.filter((x) => x.kind === 'drwDim'); return a.length + ' ' + a[0]?.dtype + ' ' + /data-annotation="dim[^"]*"[^>]*>.*?>50</s.test((document.querySelector('.drawing-paper svg')?.outerHTML ?? '')); })()

name: drw: click the hole: a diameter dimension
eval: (() => { const b = window.__viewBox('top'); const s = b.w / 100; window.__pt = window.__sheetToClient(b.x + b.w / 2 + 10 * s, b.y + b.h / 2); return 'ok'; })()

name: drw: tolerance on the picked dimension (H7 fit)
eval: (async () => { const sel = document.querySelector('[data-pm-select="tolType"]'); sel.value = 'fit'; sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400)); const svg = (document.querySelector('.drawing-paper svg')?.outerHTML ?? ''); return [svg.includes('>Ø20 H7<'), svg.includes('>+0.021<')].join(' '); })()

name: drw: model items and auto centre marks
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; await m.actions.acceptEditing(); await m.run('drwModelItems'); await m.run('drwCenterMarks'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); const d = m.active(); return [d.annotations.filter((a) => a.model).length >= 3, d.annotations.filter((a) => a.kind === 'drwCenter').length >= 2, (document.querySelector('.drawing-paper svg')?.outerHTML ?? '').includes('dx-center')].join(' '); })()

name: drw: weld symbol placed by clicking the sheet
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; await m.run('drwWeld'); window.__pt = window.__sheetToClient(60, 230); return m.state.editing?.mode; })()

name: drw: weld type, size and all-round
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; m.actions.pmSet('w:symbol', 'vGroove'); m.actions.pmFieldChanged('w:size', '6'); m.actions.pmFieldChanged('w:length', '50'); m.actions.pmToggle('w:allAround', true); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const w = m.active().annotations.find((a) => a.kind === 'drwWeld'); return [w.symbol, w.size, w.allAround, (document.querySelector('.drawing-paper svg')?.outerHTML ?? '').includes('dx-drwWeld')].join(' '); })()

name: drw: general table with edited cells
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; await m.actions.acceptEditing(); await m.run('drwTable'); window.__pt = window.__sheetToClient(30, 30); return m.state.editing?.mode; })()

name: drw: table cells
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; m.actions.pmFieldChanged('cell:0:0', 'ITEM'); m.actions.pmFieldChanged('cell:1:1', 'Ra 1.6'); await m.actions.pmCommand('drw.addRow'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const tb = m.active().annotations.find((a) => a.kind === 'drwTable'); const svg = (document.querySelector('.drawing-paper svg')?.outerHTML ?? ''); return [tb.rows, svg.includes('>ITEM<'), svg.includes('>Ra 1.6<'), document.querySelectorAll('.drw-cell').length].join(' '); })()

name: drw: layers colour and hide annotations
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; await m.actions.acceptEditing(); await m.run('drwLayers'); await m.actions.pmCommand('drw.addLayer'); await m.actions.pmCommand('drw.assignAll'); const d = m.active(); const L = d.layers[0]; m.actions.pmFieldChanged('layerColor:' + L.id, '#1565c0'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const before = (document.querySelector('.drawing-paper svg')?.outerHTML ?? '').includes('stroke="#1565c0"'); m.actions.pmToggle('layerVis:' + L.id, false); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const hidden = !(document.querySelector('.drawing-paper svg')?.outerHTML ?? '').includes('dx-drwDim'); m.actions.pmToggle('layerVis:' + L.id, true); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); return [before, hidden, (document.querySelector('.drawing-paper svg')?.outerHTML ?? '').includes('dx-drwDim')].join(' '); })()

name: drw: title block fields
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; await m.actions.acceptEditing(); await m.run('drwTitleBlock'); m.actions.pmFieldChanged('tb:title', 'Bracket'); m.actions.pmFieldChanged('tb:material', 'S355'); m.actions.pmFieldChanged('tb:revision', 'C'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const svg = (document.querySelector('.drawing-paper svg')?.outerHTML ?? ''); return [svg.includes('>Bracket<'), svg.includes('>S355<')].join(' '); })()

name: drw: ANSI sheet format with zones
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; await m.actions.acceptEditing(); await m.run('drwSheetFormat'); m.actions.pmSet('f:standard', 'ANSI'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); const d = m.active(); const svg = (document.querySelector('.drawing-paper svg')?.outerHTML ?? ''); return [d.sheet, d.projection, svg.includes('ASME Y14.5'), d.annotations.filter((a) => a.kind === 'drwDim').length > 0].join(' '); })()

name: drw: back to ISO A3
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; m.actions.pmSet('f:standard', 'ISO'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); await m.actions.acceptEditing(); const d = m.active(); return d.sheet + ' ' + d.projection; })()

name: eval: undercut analysis colours the part (no undercut along +Z)
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; m.actions.switchDocument({ kind: 'part', id: window.__part }); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); await m.run('eval_undercut'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400)); const e = m.state.editing; return [e.mode, e.kind, e.result?.undercut, Boolean(m.state.drwEval?.colors?.length), document.querySelector('.left-pm-body .eval-legend') != null].join(' '); })()

name: eval: deviation, symmetry and geometry check
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; await m.run('eval_deviation'); const dv = m.state.editing.result; await m.run('eval_symmetry'); const sy = m.state.editing.result; await m.run('eval_geometry'); const g = m.state.editing.result; return [Math.round(dv.max), sy.symmetric, g.valid, g.problems].join(' '); })()

name: eval: costing and sustainability (editable price)
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; await m.run('eval_costing'); m.actions.pmFieldChanged('cost:price', '2'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const c = m.state.editing.result.cost; await m.run('eval_sustain'); const s = m.state.editing.result.co2; return [c.price, c.total > c.materialCost, s.total > 0, document.querySelector('.left-pm-body').textContent.includes('CO₂e')].join(' '); })()

name: eval: compare with a copy that has no hole
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const p = m.project; const src = p.parts.find((x) => x.id === window.__part); const copy = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(src)); copy.id = 'pcopy'; copy.name = 'Copy'; copy.features[0].entities = copy.features[0].entities.filter((e) => e.id !== 'hc'); copy.features[0].constraints = copy.features[0].constraints.filter((c) => c.a !== 'hc'); m.actions.change('op.edit', () => { p.parts.push(copy); }); await m.run('eval_compare'); const r = m.state.editing.result; return [Math.round(r.onlyB), r.identical, r.changedFaces > 0].join(' '); })()

name: mold: parting line, shut-off, parting surface and tooling split
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; await m.actions.cancelEditing({ quiet: true }); const part = m.active(); for (const [type, extra] of [['partingLine', { dir: 'z' }], ['shutOff', {}], ['partingSurface', { distance: 40 }], ['toolingSplit', { dir: 'z', gap: 20 }]]) { await m.actions.startFeature(type); const f = m.state.editing?.feature; if (!f) return 'no ' + type; Object.assign(f, extra); await m.actions.acceptEditing(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); } const r = m.actions.buildPart(part).result; const ok = part.features.slice(-4).map((f) => r.results.get(f.id)?.ok); const ts = r.results.get(part.features.at(-1).id); return [ok.join(','), r.results.get(part.features.at(-3).id).shutOff?.count, Boolean(ts.tooling?.bySurface), ts.undercuts].join(' '); })()
